warmups: One excluded case8 solve for each CAPR model, initial seed 2040.
intervention: Only the second models.txt line (CAPR Poisson engine); no tuning, training or new model selection.
comparison: CARE-RWCap models compared with the reused DeepRWCap control, matched by case and initial FRW seed.
standard_deviation: Sample SD (ddof=1) across three model-specific 10-case macro means; includes residual FRW evaluation noise.
source_record_fields: Numerical fields copied from accepted repeat_results.csv and baseline_repeat_results.csv without rounding.
release_scope: Capacitance records and CPU reaggregation. Additional seed2039/2053 model files and original solver logs are not bundled; the default inference runner remains seed2029.
